prompt: Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 120 words). Collision type: sideswipe while changing lanes in League City, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported wrist fracture. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1306; do not mention it.)
text: Officer narrative. On arrival at the scene in League City, Texas, I observed two vehicles stopped in the right-hand lane of the eastbound roadway with visible contact damage to the left rear quarter panel of Vehicle 1 and the right front fender of Vehicle 2. Driver 1 stated that Vehicle 2 attempted to change lanes from the center lane into the lane occupied by Vehicle 1 and made contact with the left side of Vehicle 1. Driver 2 stated that they checked the mirror, saw no vehicle in the adjacent lane, and believed the lane was clear when the contact occurred. A Passenger in Vehicle 1 was seated in the front passenger seat and was not injured. Driver 1 reported pain in the right wrist and was evaluated by EMS on scene, then transported for further care. No citations were issued at the scene pending review of witness statements. Both vehicles were driven from the roadway after documentation was completed.
